local_adjustments: Family-aware DNS guard called at native startup, and owned DNS cleanup on native stop
Default stopped on first boot after flashing; boot and config reload respect stopped state; preset only on explicit start; LuCI controls persist autostart state
Service status uses actual procd processes instead of writable state directories; status RPC uses read-only initialization
Refresh only reads status; applying settings preserves stopped state

default_state.start: enable autostart and start; applies untouched preset
default_state.configuration: editable while stopped; applying settings does not start service
